name: Hellburners
description: The Hellburners were a street gang based in the Williamsburg neighborhood of Brooklyn, active during the late 1950s and early 1960s. They had a junior division known as the Young Burners, referred to as 'the Little People.' Their rivals included the Jesters, Phantom Lords, Roman Lords, and Buccaneers. Around 1960, gang members were among those reached by early Teen Challenge outreach workers.
